title: Data erasure requests
intro: Record a request from a patient to have their data removed, and follow it until an admin completes or refuses it. Every step is written to the audit log.

rules.title: What completing a request does
rules.removes: Removed: audio recordings (the speech service deletes the files at its next clean-up, within the hour), transcripts and drafts, suggested questions and shortlists, WhatsApp summaries and send records, FHIR exports, ABHA data, and allergy notes typed by staff. For a visit that was never signed, all of its working data goes too.
rules.keeps: Kept: signed visit records and the facts and medicines they rest on, the consent history, and the audit log. The patient's name and phone number belong to ClinicOS and are not changed here.
rules.open: To be confirmed: whether a signed clinical record must be kept after an erasure request is not decided here. It is a question for my guide / institution / a clinician (open item OCI-016). Until it is answered, the safer rule applies: signed records stay and everything else goes.
